headline: Madrasa super killed by bus in Rangpur, mob sets vehicle on fire
summary: A Madrasa super was killed in a road accident on the Rangpur-Dhaka highway, leading to a violent protest where angry locals blocked the highway and burned the bus.
details: A Madrasa super was killed after being hit by a bus on the Rangpur-Dhaka highway on Sunday morning. The accident occurred near the Cotton Research Center at Modern Mor in Rangpur.

headline_marked: Qatar [[suspends all maritime activity]] after Iranian missile attack
headline: Qatar suspends all maritime activity after Iranian missile attack
summary: The Qatari government has ordered a temporary halt to all vessels, including commercial ships and fishing trawlers, due to security risks.
details: Qatar has ordered a temporary suspension of all vessel movements in its territorial waters following a ballistic missile attack by Iran.
The Ministry of Transport announced the decision was made in the public interest and for safety reasons, urging ship owners to halt all maritime activities until further notice.
The suspension applies to all types of vessels, including commercial ships, recreational boats, fishing trawlers, and jet skis.
The move comes after an Iranian ballistic missile attack on Sunday morning, during which air defense systems intercepted several missiles.
Despite the interceptions, debris from the missiles fell to the ground, injuring at least three people.
The authorities confirmed that the injured individuals have been hospitalized.
The recent attack has significantly heightened security tensions in the Gulf region, raising new concerns over the safety of international shipping lanes and maritime trade.
caption:
Qatar has shut down its waters to all ships after an Iranian missile attack left three people injured.

Qatar has ordered a temporary suspension of all vessel movements in its territorial waters following a ballistic missile attack by Iran.

The Ministry of Transport announced the decision was made in the public interest and for safety reasons, urging ship owners to halt all maritime activities until further notice.

The suspension applies to all types of vessels, including commercial ships, recreational boats, fishing trawlers, and jet skis.

The move comes after an Iranian ballistic missile attack on Sunday morning, during which air defense systems intercepted several missiles.

Despite the interceptions, debris from the missiles fell to the ground, injuring at least three people.

The authorities confirmed that the injured individuals have been hospitalized.

The recent attack has significantly heightened security tensions in the Gulf region, raising new concerns over the safety of international shipping lanes and maritime trade.

#Qatar #Iran #GulfSecurity #MaritimeTrade #WorldNews
